title: Prime Nim's mod-3 bias
plain: Losing pile sizes in Prime Nim are about three times as likely to be 1 mod 3 as 0 mod 3. Find the exact limiting proportions.
math: For the prime subtraction game, prove the limits $\lim_x\#\{n\le x:G(n)=0,\ n\equiv r\ (3)\}/\#\{n\le x:G(n)=0\}$ exist for $r=0,1,2$, and determine them.
